lines: In our search for the abducted Shikanosuke, a large open space of the underground ruins suddenly appeared before us.
The ceiling became much higher, and at the back of the chamber was such a gigantic statue that we had to look up to see the whole figure.
It looked like some kind of goddess, but I had no idea which religion she came from.
Someone awaits us. Chevalier senses quite powerful magic.
It was Chevalier who spoke first.
Someone's here? Is it the Guardian that kidnapped Shikanosuke!?
The rest of us immediately had our heads on swivels, ready for anything.
It's coming!!! And I don't think it'll give us a heads-up!
Hebiko! Can your suckers locate it?
There's a weird smell all over the place! But this is...
Sensing something, Hebiko looked up at the ceiling. And thenー
Suddenly, a black shadow fell from overhead.
By the time we noticed the attack, it had already knocked Hebiko out with a single blow and flew back up to the ceiling carrying her body.
With Hebiko in its arm, it latched onto the ceiling, which was several dozen meters high,
and it quickly moved across the ceiling like a monkey, landing at a distance from us.
Was this how Shikanosuke had been taken?
Hebiko and Shikanosuke had improved considerably as Taimanin, and they even excelled at detecting enemies above all else.
And yet, they were captured so easily...
Well, well. This Guardian's more trouble than I expected. So I imagine its master must be as well...
Annreed, who had been quite light-hearted up until now, suddenly grew serious.
Quite mighty is my master, indeed.
Annreed's words surprisingly got a response.
Its manner of speech was somewhat antiquated, but it was a woman's voice.
It's a golem created by ancient magic. Of course it does.
Chevalier spoke matter-of-factly to the shocked Kirara.
The good lady understands my nature.
It's only natural. Curiosity and knowledge are what make Chevalier who she is.
A Guardian will not be an "easy" opponent like the zombies and golems you have dealt with thus far.
It is a type of undead monster. However, they have sophisticated minds, and some of them can even use magic.
Even Chevalier, who has lived for an age, has only seen a few guardians of this level.
To see them in the human world... A very interesting subject for Chevalier's research.
Brilliant insight. You have my admiration.
A strange human who possesses strong demonic power, and demons, you have brought me such a fine material. I offer you my thanks for this.
Now just hang on! Who're you calling a "material!?" You're gonna regret it if you don't give Hebiko-chan back! And Shikanosuke-kun, too!!
Hmm! You must be an Oni. And what's more, one quite dignified... divine, even! Wonderful.
Huh!? Are you even listening to me!?
One worthy of being a spare vessel.
The Guardian completely ignored Kirara-senpai and began to let out something like a low growling sound.
Wh-What's going on? She started growling all of a sudden!?
Uhh Mistress? Isn't that some kind of magic?
Quite correct. She's trying to summon something.
Hey! You should've said that earlier! What're you waiting around for!?
I have to know what kind of magic she uses. This is why Chevalier came here, after all.
Agh, jeez! This is why I can't stand witches!!
As soon as she said that, the space in front of us distorted, and enemies came crawling out of the void.
Our old friendsーthe zombies and golems we had already grown quite accustomed toーwere back. But this time their numbers were even greater than before.
At a quick glance, there were at least 20. And more and more swarmed forth.
I-Isn't this a bit too many...?
It looks like she's simply summoning monsters from someplace else she prepared beforehand. How very dull.
No, that's not what I meant.
No matter how many they throw at us, small fries are small fries, right? I'll just show them all what I can do!
Hmm, was this worth waiting for, Mistress?
Uhh, listen you can be disillusioned all you want but I think we should start worrying about how she seems to mean business...
In which case, it was my turn to do some work finally.
Not only was Shikanosuke gone but Hebiko as well. Nevertheless, I started giving commands to our remaining three members.
Kirara-senpai, please take out the small fries first.
Annreed, I'm counting on you to watch for her surprise attacks. And make sure you back up Kirara-senpai too.
Chevalier, no reading this time. You fight with us.
Understood! I'll freeze every last one of them!
I'm gonna drag out her master real soon.
They each gave their own characteristic response before they rushed into battle.
